Name: Custom NPC - Yoba (1.6 Compatible)
Author: JER3M7
Description:
[left]I made Yoba, the god mentioned in the game, as a custom NPC.

Please note that he is almost made from my imagination except for his name and may be very different from the official setting.

I'm using a translator and I apologize if my words seem strange. 

Please enjoy my custom character.[/left]
[b][size=4][i]+2024.07.31 1.6 Update complete. [/i][/size][/b]





-



[b][size=3]Hi, I'm using a translator and I can't understand exactly what you're saying,
but I thought I'd answer what I can. [/size][/b]




[size=4][b]Q. [i]Is it possible to update so that I can date Yoba?[/i]

A.[/b] I am indeed planning a romantic event, but it will not lead to a possible marriage.
He probably won't be able to date in the future either, but you are special to him even now.





[b]Q. [i]Is it compatible with SVE?[/i][/b]

[b]A. [/b]Not compatible, I've gotten so many inquiries about it,
but I'm still considering it and nothing is certain. 





[b]Q. [/b][i][b]Can I translate it?[/b][/i]

[b]A. [/b]Translations and retextures do not require my permission, please feel free!

Just don't use my drawn sources without permission, and don't forget to credit me. I've lovingly drawn my sauces and I'd be so devastated if someone else passed them off as their own that I'd seriously want to die. (I recommend you don't think I'm exaggerating).





I actually didn't expect my mod to get this much attention. I'm so glad!
Thank you to everyone who has thought positively of my mod.

And I apologize for not replying to every message.
I hope my words came across well.
[/size]
